ROOT.proceduredef: CREATE PROCEDURE cdn.CreateSrtLinki AS begin DECLARE @n int DECLARE @GidTyp SMALLINT DECLARE @GidFirma INT DECLARE @GidNumer INT DECLARE @GroTyp SMALLINT DECLARE @GroFirma INT DECLARE @GroNumer INT DECLARE @InsertedGroNumer INT DECLARE @prevcount INT DECLARE @count INT DELETE FROM CDN.SrtLinki DECLARE gc CURSOR FOR SELECT SrG_GIDTyp,SrG_GIDFirma,SrG_GIDNumer, SrG_GROTyp,SrG_GROFirma,SrG_GRONumer FROM CDN.SrtGrupy WHERE SrG_GIDTyp=368 OPEN gc FETCH NEXT FROM gc INTO @GidTyp,@GidFirma,@GidNumer,@GroTyp,@GroFirma,@GroNumer WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN SET @prevcount=0 SET @count=-1 CREATE TABLE #gronumery(GN INT,C INT) INSERT INTO #gronumery exec CDN.SrtRodzice @GroNumer INSERT INTO CDN.SrtLinki SELECT @GIDTyp,@GIDFirma,@GIDNumer,0,-368,@GROFirma,GN,0,0,0 FROM (SELECT @GIDNumer as GIDNr,GN,Linki.SrL_GRONumer as GRO FROM #gronumery LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.SrtLinki AS Linki ON Linki.SrL_GIDNumer=@GIDNumer AND Linki.SrL_GRONumer=GN) SelectWewn WHERE GRO IS NULL UPDATE CDN.SrtLinki SET SrL_LiczbaPowtorzen=SrL_LiczbaPowtorzen+(SELECT c FROM #gronumery WHERE GN=SrL_GRONumer) WHERE SrL_GiDTyp = @GidTyp AND SrL_GiDFirma = @GidFirma AND SrL_GiDNumer = @GidNumer AND SrL_GroTyp = @GroTyp AND SrL_GroFirma = @GroFirma AND SrL_GroNumer IN (SELECT GN FROM #gronumery) UPDATE CDN.SrtLinki SET SrL_Lisc=1 WHERE SrL_GiDTyp = @GidTyp AND SrL_GiDFirma = @GidFirma AND SrL_GiDNumer = @GidNumer AND SrL_GroTyp = @GroTyp AND SrL_GroFirma = @GroFirma AND SrL_GroNumer =@GROnumer DROP TABLE #gronumery FETCH NEXT FROM gc INTO @GidTyp,@GidFirma,@GidNumer,@GroTyp,@GroFirma,@GroNumer END CLOSE gc DEALLOCATE gc; end;
